title: Greetings
label: ch:greetings
canDo: I can greet someone in Arabic, recognize the reply, and choose an appropriate response.

payoff.summary: Complete AR-C01-practice, the canonical closing checkpoint, and demonstrate the chapter promise: greet someone in Arabic, recognize the reply, and choose an appropriate response.
payoff.note: AR-C01-practice assesses all twenty-five atoms the chapter introduces: reading the greetings and the three anchor words right to left, the greeting-and-reply exchange, delayed transcription of salām, and a from-memory recall of joining, al- and its sun/moon rule, the new letters and hamza, the time-of-day roots and their light-replies, and the sh-k-r patterns with ʿafwan.
